mathematics.assertion_tested: Soft scalar-scattering cooling condition, local restoring mode, and explicit thin-wall conversion kinetics
mathematics.conventions: SI cooling variables; natural-unit canonical scalar bounce; dilute radiation without induced scattering; prescribed bath and fixed local density
inputs: Existing scalar contact elastic and annihilation rates
Canonical tilted quartic in thin-wall flat-space limit

bounds.scope: Soft radiation E and thermal energy much less than mc^2; small phase splitting; fixed prefactor/rate and bubble speed in growth model

non_claims: No bath supplied by a calculated vacuum decay history
No fluctuation prefactor or wall speed calculated
